name: NameRobot
summary: Naming tools for companies and products: a toolbox of 100+ name generators, an AI naming assistant, and paid NameScore reports that check availability, trademarks and the sound of a name.
best_for: founders, agencies and marketers naming a company or product who want generators plus a paid availability and sound check per name, without a subscription
skip_if: you need full legal trademark clearance, or you only want a quick list of free name ideas with no checks
honest_knock: NameScore prices are shown as offers against regular prices twice as high, with no end date, and the Naming Toolbox premium price is not printed on namerobot.com. The automated trademark and availability checks are a screening, not legal clearance. NameScore is sold for commercial use and prices exclude VAT, which EU buyers without a VAT ID pay on top. We have not used NameRobot ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: NameScore, 1 NameReport · one-time, excluding VAT, shown as an offer against a regular $39
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on namerobot.com in a browser render, USD) NameRobot sells several naming tools. NameScore checks a name and returns a NameReport; it is a one-time payment, not a subscription, priced per number of reports, excluding VAT and marked as an offer for commercial use only, each shown against a higher regular price: 1 report $19.00 (regular $39.00), 5 reports $49.00 ($99.00), 10 reports $75.00 ($149.00) and 100 reports $249.00 ($499.00). Namefruits, the AI name generator, is a one-time payment of $99 per naming project, with a free start where you collect words, rate examples and set preferences before paying for full access. The Naming Toolbox, with 100+ name generators and availability checks, is free to try; its premium membership is a subscription whose price is not printed on namerobot.com. Trademarkly, a trademark lookup, is described as free. The payment FAQ lists PayPal, credit card, invoice and SEPA on request, and says EU customers without a VAT ID pay VAT.

compare_with.name: Zoviz
compare_with.why: Zoviz is in our dossiers too, but it designs the logo and brand kit after you have a name; NameRobot works one step earlier, on finding and checking the name itself. Many founders need both, in that order.
